summary: Validated MongoDB compound-index perf fix for GET /api/leads against 120,000 seeded leads. All 8 pytest cases pass in ~2.7s total; every request returned HTTP 200 in well under 250ms.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Perf test suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_leads_perf.py; safe regression harness for /api/leads.
rca of the issue: Prior sort tuple [(sort_field,dir),('id',-1)] wasn't covered by {active:1,create_date:-1} index, causing MongoDB blocking in-memory SORT over ~100k docs -> slow / >32MB 500. New compound indexes {active:1,create_date:-1,id:-1} and {active:1,user_id:1,create_date:-1,id:-1} now fully cover both admin and caller-scoped default sorts; verified via <250ms response over 120k docs.
